name: Acumbamail

evidence.marketing: F02: automated email journeys, autoresponders and RSS campaigns; F01 says email-marketing service
evidence.newsletter: F02: newsletters and one-off campaigns with A/B tests
evidence.transactional: F02: transactional SMTP for confirmations and password resets; needs a paid plan and support activation (F05)
evidence.multichannel: F02: automated email and SMS journeys; SMS is an optional paid extra (F12)

line: Email campaigns, automated journeys, and transactional sending.

free.text: Free up to 250 subscribers and 2,000 emails/month

cells.api: Yes; SMTP needs paid plan and support activation

subs.math: 1,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 4,000 emails a month. The 20,000-email plan costs €31 a month before tax.
5,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 20,000 emails a month. The 20,000-email plan costs €31 a month before tax.
10,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 40,000 emails a month. The 40,000-email plan costs €58 a month before tax.
50,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 200,000 emails a month. The 300,000-email plan costs €231 a month before tax.
